edge_intra_01.reading: the gross expectation is negative in every window measured, before a single fee is charged: DEV:BASE -151.71 USDT over 290 trades (-10.46 bps/trade); OOS:BASE -19.91 USDT over 63 trades (-6.32 bps/trade); VAL:BASE -70.15 USDT over 344 trades (-4.08 bps/trade). Costs are the larger part of the net loss, but they are not the cause: a book that needed only a fee cut would show a positive gross against a negative net. Lowering fees cannot move a negative expectancy across zero — only a different setup, a different entry, or a longer hold can.

decomposition.method: per-trade rows from the frozen campaign's TRADES.csv; gross, fees, price costs and net are the fields the simulator itself wrote, so nothing is re-derived from a curve. Windows are the frozen DEV/VAL/OOS bounds of the campaign.

reused_campaign.note: these figures were measured by the WP-EDGE-01 campaign, not by this work package: the audit reads them and the digests above say which bytes it read
